{{Quote|Very recently, our Boss was taken prisoner by one of the bombad evil tribes!|The Gungan villager, speaking of Hoxie|audio=GN2-TRECG-L26.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] '''villager''' lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Raban]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[3000 BBY]]. During a [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes at that [[Time/Legends|time]], the villager witnessed the [[Kidnapping of Hoxie|kidnapping]] of the city's leader, [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Hoxie]], by the Gungan [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]]. The villager later told Rogoe's rival, [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], about the Boss's abduction, and joined Gallo's cause when the latter [[Battle of the Forest Cities|rescued]] Hoxie.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Boss has returned! Wesa are at your service, Gallo.|The Gungan villager, following Hoxie's rescue|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:Otoh_Raban.png|thumb|right|300px|Otoh Raban, the villager's home]]
A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] villager lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Raban]], under the leadership of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Hoxie]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the [[War of the Gungan tribes|Gungan war]], in which the villager experienced, in [[3000 BBY]].</ref> During a [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes at that [[Time/Legends|time]], the villager saw the [[Kidnapping of Hoxie|kidnapping]] of Hoxie committed by the [[Rogoe's army|forces]] of the Gungan [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]] in order to cause Otoh Raban to continue fighting in the conflict in the absence of their leader. Later, the villager encountered Boss [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], a Gungan who was attempting to unite the tribes against Rogoe, and the villager told him of Hoxie's kidnapping, and also warned that Otoh Raban would keep fighting until their Boss was returned. Gallo agreed to [[Battle of the Forest Cities|rescue]] Hoxie to gain Otoh Raban's allegiance and, after following up rumors of a [[Rogoe's stronghold|prison camp]] north of Otoh Raban that belonged to Rogoe, found Hoxie there and brought him back to his city. The villager thanked Gallo for rescuing Hoxie, and they, along with the rest of Otoh Raban, joined Gallo's crusade against Rogoe.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Until hesa is returned safe and sound, it will be war for usen!|The villager, to Gallo, on Hoxie|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The Gungan villager lived under the leadership of Boss Hoxie and was willing to ask for Gallo's help in recovering Otoh Raban's leader during his capture. The villager was also convinced that Otoh Raban would remain in the war if Hoxie was not returned safely but was ready to join Gallo's cause as soon as the Boss was rescued.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan villager's voice is heard in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', and also in its [[2002]] expansion, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']]. In the game's credits, two actors are credited as voicing Gungan villagers, [[Rob Paulsen]] and [[Grey Griffin|Grey DeLisle]], but it is not identified which one, if either, voiced this villager.
